s01.longHint: Checking the connection to the server

check.title: Stage 1 · skeleton
check.note: The home screen with duels will live here. For now we check that every part of the app is connected.

outside.title: Open in Telegram
outside.text: Quiz Duel runs inside Telegram: that's how we know who's playing and keep your rating.

error.title: The server isn't responding
error.text: Check your connection and try again. If a game was in progress, it's saved on the server.

session.title: Open again
session.text: Your sign-in data has expired or failed the check. Close the app and open it again from the bot.
